title: [family.foobench] of a source profile (docs/architecture D.4.1, D.12.1)
description: Closed schema of the family table of the foobench profile: the main thread's name, the closed guard-verdict and approval-decision tables (foobench.verdict_table@1), the approver table and the actor table (foobench.actor_table@1).

main_thread.description: The thread label that is the attempt; any other thread is a thread scope.

guard_verdicts.description: Source guard verdict string -> AER decision verdict.

approval_decisions.description: Source approval decision string -> AER decision verdict.

approvers.description: Source approver label -> a key of `actors`.

call_role.description: model_call.role of this actor's calls (default agent).

model_from.description: Header member that names the requested model.

model_file.description: Which file's header holds that member (default primary).
